```kotlin
    val x = readLine()!!.toBigInteger()

        k1
    } else {
        k2
    }
    val result = minDeviation.remainder(BigInteger.valueOf(4))
    println(result)
}
```

```kotlin
import java.math.BigInteger

fun main() {
    val x = readLine()!!.toBigInteger()
    val mod = BigInteger.valueOf(360)
    val angle = x.remainder(mod)
    val normalized = if (angle < BigInteger.ZERO) angle.add(mod) else angle
    val remainder = normalized.remainder(BigInteger.valueOf(90))
    val quotient = normalized.divide(BigInteger.valueOf(90))
    val candidate1 = quotient
    val candidate2 = quotient.add(BigInteger.ONE)
    val diff1 = remainder
    val diff2 = BigInteger.valueOf(90).subtract(remainder)
    val best = if (diff1 <= diff2) candidate1 else candidate2
    val result = best.remainder(BigInteger.valueOf(4))
    println(result)
}
```

```kotlin
    val bestDev = minOf(dev0, dev1)
```

```kotlin
fun main() {
    val x = readLine()!!.toLong()
    val totalRotation = (-x) % 360
    val normalized = (totalRotation + 360) % 360
    val remainder = normalized % 90
    val steps = (normalized / 90).toInt()
    val option1 = steps
    val option2 = (steps + 1) % 4
    val option3 = (steps - 1 + 4) % 4
    val candidates = listOf(option1, option2, option3)
    val minDeviation = candidates.minOf { k ->
        val angle = (normalized + k * 90) % 360
        val dev = if (angle <= 180) angle else 360 - angle
        dev
    }
    val bestK = candidates.minByOrNull { k ->
        val angle = (normalized + k * 90) % 360
        val dev = if (angle <= 180) angle else 360 - angle
        dev
    }
    println(bestK)
}
```

```kotlin
fun main() {
    val x = readLine()!!.toLong()
    val totalRotation = (-x) % 360
    val normalized = if (totalRotation < 0) totalRotation + 360 else totalRotation
    val rem = normalized % 90
    val k0 = (normalized / 90) % 4
    val candidates = listOf(k0, (k0 + 1) % 4, (k0 - 1 + 4) % 4)
    var bestK = -1
    var minDev = Int.MAX_VALUE
    for (k in candidates) {
        val angle = (k * 90 - normalized).toInt()
        val dev = Math.abs(angle) % 360
        val devMin = Math.min(dev, 360 - dev)
        if (devMin < minDev || (devMin == minDev && k < bestK)) {
            minDev = devMin
            bestK = k
        }
    }
    println(bestK)
}
```

1

-60

3
